summary: Frontend-only mobile regression verified dynamic 3-board status, manual rotation, set rollover, theme toggle, and rules modal at the public Expo preview.

ui_bugs.issue: At 375x667 after opening the rules modal, the Close rules button is outside the viewport and cannot be tapped normally; the modal is difficult/impossible to dismiss via UI.

action_items: Fix rules bottom-sheet/header layout so close-rules remains within the 375px mobile viewport and is tappable.
critical_code_review_comments: History items continue to use board.number as the React key; numbering resets after set rollover and can produce duplicate keys.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Continuous mobile session passed app load, 3-board configuration, Board 1 of 3 status, manual rotate, rollover to SET 2 OF 3 / Board 1 of 3, theme toggle, and rules modal opening. Test ended because close-rules was outside viewport.
rca_of_issue: The rules sheet header is rendered inside a max-height 88% bottom sheet and the close icon is laid out at the far right of a wide appbar/header context; at 375px the rendered sheet content is horizontally clipped, placing close-rules beyond the viewport. Reproduce by opening rules-button at 375x667 and attempting close-rules.
